svg.title: About me
svg.desc: I am a curious, creative person with a passion for technology, design and innovation. I love exploring new ideas, understanding how things work and turning what I imagine into real projects. My experience combines programming, 3D design and software development, with a particular interest in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Much of what I know comes from experimenting, researching and taking on new challenges independently. I enjoy finding original solutions, paying attention to detail and constantly learning, always with the ambition to create things that go a little beyond the conventional.
